why: the frozen analysis.py crashed with IndexError when a bootstrap array was empty (numpy quantile on size-0 input). Discovered by a dry run BEFORE the confirmation labels existed.
scope: robustness only: (1) ci95() returns [nan, nan] for an empty bootstrap array instead of raising; (2) a P2 comparison whose residual difference or CI is undefined counts as NOT decided. No estimator, threshold, prediction or verdict rule is changed.

--- /tmp/analysis_frozen.py	2026-09-24 11:49:24.198075008 +0000
+++ code/analysis.py	2026-09-24 11:51:58.000000000 +0000
@@ -19,6 +19,16 @@
 B = 2000
 
 
+def ci95(a) -> list:
+    """2.5/97.5 percentiles of a bootstrap array, [nan, nan] when the array is empty (post-freeze robustness patch:
+    definition-preserving, see results/analysis_patch.json)."""
+    a = np.asarray(a, dtype=float)
+    a = a[~np.isnan(a)]
+    if a.size == 0:
+        return [float("nan"), float("nan")]
+    return [float(np.quantile(a, 0.025)), float(np.quantile(a, 0.975))]
+
